MAR.note: Decree 2.23.980 concerns e-petitions, not e-commerce or electronic transactions.
Mentions the electoral-list registration number only as a step for petition sign-up; says nothing of the roll's state.
The petition platform only allows preparing a petition; signing and filing are blocked, so no channel is stated in service and no consultation is stated.
A civil-society complaint about a petition platform; no named digital law or policy put to people outside government.
